title: S-EVAL: Towards Automated and Comprehensive Safety Evaluation for Large Language Models
findings: The paper does not report specific findings for the religion subcategory. Results are aggregated into higher-level risk dimensions, such as 'Extremism (EX)' and 'Ethics and Morality (EM)', which include religious discrimination.
